about: Keyboard alternatives for people who can't use a mouse well. Everything fl-headless does already works by chat; these are FL's own keys for doing things by hand. FL's defaults - verify on your FL version (checklists/access.md); users can override in <state folder>/access/keys.json.

by_chat.a popup is open: fl_dialog (list, then click a button by name)
by_chat.change a channel or mixer track: fl_channel_set / fl_mixer_set (volume, pan, mute, name, color)
